headline: Goa Launches Ujjwala Scheme with LPG Subsidies
summary: The Goa government has launched the Goa Ujjwala Yojana, providing three free LPG cylinders annually to eligible beneficiaries. Under this scheme, consumers will receive a reimbursement of Rs 3,000 directly into their accounts.

headline: Amit Shah Begins Three-Day Goa Visit
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah arrived in Goa to chair the 28th Western Zonal Council meeting in Panaji. During his three-day visit, he will also review home ministry affairs, lead an anti-narcotics drive, and discuss key state political strategies.

headline: Man Dies After Self-Stabbing During Dispute in Siolim
summary: A dispute in Siolim took a tragic turn after a man reportedly stabbed himself, leading to his death. Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the altercation.

headline: Speeding Mercedes Driver Arrested After Fatal Crash
summary: A speeding Mercedes in Goa rammed into a scooter, dragging it for nearly two kilometers and killing the rider while injuring the pillion. The driver has been arrested in connection with the tragic accident.

headline: CM Highlights Historic Temple Restorations in Goa
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant stated that around 1,000 temples were destroyed during Portuguese rule as he marked the beginning of the Saptakoteshwar temple restoration. He emphasized the government's commitment to reviving Goa's cultural heritage.

headline: War Hero Abhinandan Varthaman Joins Goa-Based FLY91
summary: Group Captain Abhinandan Varthaman, known for shooting down a Pakistani jet in 2019, has retired from the Indian Air Force. He has now joined Goa-based regional airline FLY91 as a commercial pilot.

headline: Goa Passes Advocates Protection Act with Jail Terms
summary: The Goa Legislative Assembly has passed the Advocates Protection Act to deter violence against legal professionals. The new legislation prescribes up to seven years of imprisonment for assaulting lawyers.

headline: Goa Shifts Tourism Focus Beyond Beaches
summary: Goa's tourism department is aiming to showcase its diverse inland experiences at the Amritsar travel mart to shed its 'beach-only' image. The state recently crossed a major milestone, welcoming over one crore domestic tourists.

headline: Exploring Quiet Alternatives to Busy Goa Beaches
summary: Travel experts are highlighting quieter, crowd-free coastal alternatives across India for travelers seeking a peaceful beach holiday. These destinations offer a serene escape from Goa's increasingly crowded shores.

headline: What a Rs 30,000 Monthly Budget Gets You in Goa
summary: Remote workers relocating to Goa are sharing breakdowns of their monthly living expenses, which total around Rs 30,000. The budget covers accommodation, scooter rentals, food, and utilities, showcasing the cost of a coastal lifestyle.

headline: Prashant Joshi Elected Chairman of Goa FADA
summary: Prashant Joshi has been elected as the Chairman of the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations (FADA) Goa chapter for the 2026-28 term. He will lead the state's automobile dealership community over the next two years.

headline: Private Shacks in CRZ Must Register with Tourism Dept
summary: The Goa government has tightened regulations, making it mandatory for private shacks in the Coastal Regulation Zone to register with the tourism department. The move aims to streamline beach operations and enforce compliance.

headline: Assembly Passes Bill for Joint Venture Housing Projects
summary: The Goa assembly has cleared a new bill empowering the housing board to undertake development projects through joint ventures. This revenue-sharing model is expected to boost housing infrastructure across the state.

headline: Goa to Compensate Artists Affected by Natural Calamities
summary: The Goa government has introduced a framework to compensate local artists whose homes have been destroyed by natural disasters. The initiative aims to provide essential relief and housing support to the state's cultural community.

headline: French Navy Frigate Languedoc Concludes Goa Visit
summary: The French Navy's multi-mission frigate Languedoc has successfully completed a port call at Mormugao. The stopover was part of its ongoing deployment in the Red Sea and Indian Ocean regions.

headline: Jamshedpur FC Players Cleared to Sign with Other Clubs
summary: Following a complete payout of their dues, Jamshedpur FC players are now free to seek opportunities and sign contracts with other football clubs. The financial settlement allows the squad to look for new options elsewhere.

headline: Delayed Fitness Certificate Fees Capped Until 2027
summary: The government has capped the late fee for vehicle fitness certificates at Rs 1,000 until May 2027. This temporary relief aims to help vehicle owners complete pending registrations without facing steep penalties.

headline: Har Ghar Fibre Work in Sanquelim and Bicholim to Take 270 Days
summary: The implementation of the Har Ghar Fibre internet project in Sanquelim and Bicholim is scheduled to take 270 days to complete. The initiative will significantly improve high-speed digital connectivity in these regions.

headline: Goan Pilgrims Survive Tibet Flash Floods During Yatra
summary: A group of Goan pilgrims safely completed their Kailash Yatra after surviving a sudden flash flood in the Nepal-Tibet border region. All members of the tour group are reported to be safe and returning home.

headline: Air India Express to Resume Daily Goa-Dubai Flights
summary: Air India Express has announced the resumption of its direct flight services between Goa and Dubai, starting in the Winter 2026 schedule. The airline will operate daily flights to cater to the growing travel demand.

headline: Cop in Trouble After Free Cheese Garlic Naan Dispute
summary: A dispute over a Rs 170 cheese garlic naan bill reached the Goa assembly, landing a local policeman in trouble. The cop allegedly misused his authority over the restaurant bill, leading to an official inquiry.

headline: South Goa District Collector Intervenes in SGPDA Market Issue
summary: The South Goa District Collector has stepped in to resolve the ongoing management and cleanliness issues at the SGPDA market. The intervention aims to restore order and address grievances from vendors and shoppers.

headline: Speaker Lifts Assembly Ban on Mirabag Protesters
summary: Citing democratic principles and leniency, the Goa Assembly Speaker has revoked the entry ban previously imposed on Mirabag protesters. The decision allows the citizens to engage with their representatives once again.

headline: CM Promises Solution to Karapur Project Row
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has announced that a resolution to the ongoing Karapur project dispute is expected within two days. The government is actively mediating to address the concerns of local residents.

headline: Goa Proposes Special Reserve to Protect Mud Crabs
summary: To protect berried mud crabs, the Goa government is considering new incentives and the creation of a dedicated crab reserve. The initiative aims to support marine biodiversity and local coastal ecosystems.

headline: Goa to Align Engineering Academic Calendar Nationally
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that Goa will align its engineering college schedules with national academic standards. The move is expected to benefit local students seeking national opportunities and internships.

headline: Goa Regularizes Contract Staff with 10 Years of Service
summary: The Goa government has announced the regularization of contract employees who have completed at least ten years of service. The decision brings long-awaited job security to hundreds of public sector workers.

headline: Two Leopards Spotted Near Ajoba Temple in Keri
summary: Panic and excitement hit Keri residents after two leopards were spotted roaming near the local Ajoba temple. Wildlife authorities have been alerted to monitor the big cats' movements in the area.

headline: Inadequate Charging Setup Causes Goa to Miss EV Targets
summary: Goa has failed to meet its electric vehicle adoption targets, with the government pointing to high vehicle costs and insufficient charging infrastructure. Efforts are underway to scale up public charging stations across the state.

headline: Akkalkot Swami Samarth Temple Draws Large Crowds
summary: The Akkalkot Swami Samarth temple in Goa continues to attract a massive influx of devotees seeking blessings and spiritual solace. Visitors often share stories of faith and miracles associated with the sacred site.
